text:
Raj Patel: Hey folks, first day here — stuck on Okta MFA. Okta sends an SMS but the code never arrives to +44 number. Anyone seen this before?
Sam (IT): Hi Raj, welcome! Can you DM me the last 3 digits of the phone? Also try installing Okta Verify app (it's usually more reliable than SMS).
Raj Patel: Last 3 digits are 789. I tried Okta Verify and it shows 'Device enrollment failed'. Screenshot attached (sent).
Emily (People Ops): Looping in @Sam and @Lena. Also @Onboard Bot — can we confirm Raj's Google Workspace and 1Password seats so he can access the Engineering onboarding folder?
Sam (IT): Looking at the org logs — our SMS gateway is currently blocking outbound to that mobile block/range for a handful of UK carriers (we're investigating). Workaround: I'll enable email-based backup codes temporarily and send you a one-time code. Reply 'USED' when you've logged in with it. I'll also open a ticket with the SMS provider.
Raj Patel: Got the backup code via email and used it, thanks. Okta now prompts to register either a passkey or a hardware key (YubiKey). I don't have a YubiKey yet — can I set up a passkey on my Mac for now?
Lena (Dev Lead): Passkeys are fine for day-to-day. If you hit GitHub SSO issues later ping me. Also note 1Password is needed for team SSH items — @Emily any update?
Emily (People Ops): 1Password seat provisioned and invite sent to raj.patel@redwood.com — check spam/junk. Added you to 'Engineering / Onboarding' GDrive folder and the #new-hires wiki. Welcome aboard!
Raj Patel: Found the 1Password invite, thanks. Quick SSH question: our key policy says ed25519 with an email comment — is this the right command?
Raj Patel: ```ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -C "raj@redwood.com"```
Sam (IT): Yep that's exactly it. After generating, paste the public key into the 1Password item named 'Engineering SSH keys' or add it to GitHub via your SSO flow. To test: `ssh -T git@github.com`.
Raj Patel: Done, test worked and I can clone the starter repo. :thumbsup: Thanks everyone!
Onboard Bot: Reminder: checklist item 'Complete Okta MFA' marked complete for Raj Patel.
